title: Equilibrium point configurations on the line
exact_target: Must an infinite equilibrium configuration of identical particles with inverse-square repulsion be equally spaced?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000003 (AMR-099-0003). CC BY 4.0.
Agelos Georgakopoulos and Mihail N. Kolountzakis, \emph{On particles in equilibrium on the real line}, arXiv:1604.01649v1 (2016), Section 1, Problem 1 and definition of equilibrium, pp. 1--2.
